name: Makasaysayang Pananda ng NHCP — Rehiyon ng Bicol (Region V)
title: Makasaysayang Pananda ng NHCP — Rehiyon ng Bicol (Region V)
description: Mga makasaysayang pananda ng Pambansang Komisyong Pangkasaysayan ng Pilipinas (NHCP) sa rehiyon na Rehiyon ng Bicol (Region V). Filtered subset ng pambansang tl-bantayog-pangkasaysayan (53 pananda mula sa 1235 pambansa). Bawat tala ay naglalaman ng Wikidata Q-ID, pangalan, address, petsa ng paglalagay, koordinada (lat/lon WGS84), inskripsyon sa Tagalog/Ingles (HTML), litrato ng pananda (kung mayroon), at Wikipedia/Commons na link. (NHCP historical markers in Bicol Region (Region V) — filtered subset of the national NHCP marker inventory, 53 of 1235 nationally.)

rows.name: Colegio de Santa Isabel
rows.address: Universidad de Sta. Isabel, Elias Angeles Street, Naga, Camarines Sur
rows.inscription_en: The Rt. Rev. Francisco C. Gainza, O.P., Bishop of Nueva Caceres (1862–1879), was the promoter and founder of this college named in honor of Saint Isabel, Queen of Hungary. It was solemnly blessed and opened September 18, 1870. By a royal decree of January 11, 1872, it became the first normal school for girls in the Philippines. During its existence from 1877 to 1898, three hundred students were graduated.
rows.inscription_photo: file: Colegio de Santa Isabel historical marker.jpg; credit: Carlo Joseph Moskito; perspective correction: Ervin Malicdem (schadow1) {CC BY‑SA 4.0}; width: 2729; height: 2686

rows.name: Church of Nuestra Señora de Peña de Francia
rows.address: Our Lady of Peñafrancia Shrine, Peñafrancia Avenue, Naga, Camarines Sur
rows.title_en: Church of Nuestra Señora de Peña de Francia
rows.inscription_en: The early church dedicated to “Nuestra Señora de Peña de Francia” was built about 1711 trough the generosity of the Rev. Miguel de Covarrubias as a vow-offering for blessings he received in his youth. The present church was built about 1750 by Bishop Isidoro de Arevalo and repaired and improved in 1876–1877 by Bishop Francisco Gainza. The image was solemnly crowned by the Rt. Rev. Guillermo Piani on September 20, 1924.

rows.location_description: The historical marker is located at the base of the facade pilaster between the left and middle entrance doors of the shrine.

rows.name: Cathedral of Naga
rows.address: Naga Cathedral, Elias Angeles Street, Naga, Camarines Sur
rows.inscription_en: Erected of Padi-an when the Diocese of Nueva Caceres was created by a Papal bull of 14 August 1595. Destroyed by fire, 1768. Construction of present cathedral in Spanish-Romanesque style began by Bishop Bernardo de la Concepcion, 1808. Finished and blessed by Mons. Tomas Ladron de Guevara, 1843. Damaged by typhoon, October, 1856; restored by the Very Reverend Fray Francisco Gainza, 1862–1879. Damaged by earthquake, 1887; repaired by Obras Publicas under the direction of Bishop Arsenio Campo and engineer Ricardo Ayuso, 1890.
rows.inscription_photo: height: 4160; width: 3120; credit: Carlo Joseph Moskito {CC BY‑SA 4.0}; file: Cathedral of Naga historical marker.jpg

rows.name: Holy Rosary Seminary
rows.address: Holy Rosary Minor Seminary, Elias Angeles Street, Naga, Camarines Sur
rows.inscription_tl:
Dating Casa de Clerigos na itinatag ni Obispo Andres Gonzales, O.P., sirka 1700. Ipinatayo ni Obispo Juan Antonio de Orbigo, O.F.M., ang bagong bahay seminaryo, 1785; Pinanganlang Seminario Conciliar de Nueva Caceres. Pinasinayaan ni Obispo Domingo Collantes, O.P., 1793; Natapos noong 1845. Nasira ng bagyo, 1856; at tinupok ng apoy, 1860. Muling ipinatayo at pinalaki ni Obispo Francisco Gainza, O.P., 1862; Inilipat ang pamamahala sa Vincentian Fathers, 1865. Pinanganlang Seminario del Santisimo Rosario ni Obispo Francisco Reyes, 1925. Bahagyang nasira nang bombahin ng mga sundalong Hapon, 1945, at ipinaayos ni Arsobispo Pedro Santos. Pinanganlang Holy Rosary Seminary sa ilalim ng klerikong Diyosesano, 1964. Malubhang napinsala ng bagyo, ipinaayos ni Arsobispo Teopisto Alberto, 1970. Bukod sa ilang pambansang bayani, mga martir at rebulusyonaryo, 19 sa mga obispo na kasalukuyang nakatalaga sa iba’t ibang bahagi ng kapuluan ang katangi-tanging kontribusyon ng seminaryong ito.

Sa bisa ng kautusan ng Pangulo bilang 260, 1 Agosto 1973, na sinusugna ng mga Kautusan bilang 375, 14 Enero 1974, at bilang 1505, 11 Hunyo 1978, ang seminaryong ito ay ipinahahayag na Pambansang Palatandaang Makasaysayan.
rows.inscription_photo: file: Holy Rosary Minor Seminary NCHP Marker.jpg; credit: Jun Pasa {CC BY‑SA 3.0}; width: 1526; height: 2211
rows.location_photo: width: 3812; file: Holy Rosary Minor Seminary detailed facade.jpg; credit: Jun pasa {CC BY‑SA 3.0}; height: 2848

rows.name: University of Nueva Caceres
rows.address: University of Nueva Caceres, J. Hernandez Avenue, Naga, Camarines Sur
rows.inscription_tl: Itinatag sa daang Burgos, lungsod ng Naga sa pamumuno ni Dr. Jaime Hernandez, unang pangulo, 1948. Pinagtibay ng Securities and Exchange Commission bilang Nueva Caceres Colleges, 18 Mayo 1948. Binuksan ang sekondarya at mga kursong pangkolehiyo, 1 Hulyo 1948; elementarya at ROTC, 1949. Inilipat sa daang J. Hernandez, 1952. Unang paaralan sa Kabikulan na ginawaran ng katayuang unibersidad, 15 Disyembre 1954.
rows.inscription_photo: height: 5701; credit: Jonathan Blaza {CC BY‑SA 4.0}; file: University of Nueva Caceres Historical Marker.jpg; width: 3776

rows.name: Labinlimang Martir ng Bikol
rows.address: Plaza Quince Martires, Peñafrancia Avenue, Naga, Camarines Sur
rows.inscription_tl:
Mga ilustrado ng Bikol na dinakip at nilitis ng Komisyong Militar noong 29 Disyembre 1896 sa bintang na balak na pagpatay sa lahat ng Kastila sa iba’t ibang dako ng Kabikulan. Walang kasalanan sa krimeng ibinibintang sa kanila. Sila ay binaril sa Luneta, Maynila, noong 4 Enero 1897.

Mga binaril: Domingo Abella, Manuel Abella, P. Severino Diaz, P. Inocencio Herrera, Camilo Jacob, Florencio Lerma, Mariano Melgarejo, Cornelio Mercado, P. Gabriel Prieto, Tomas Prieto at Macario Valentin. Namatay sa bilangguan: Leon Hernandez at Mariano Ordenanza. Namatay samantalang tapon: Ramon Abella at Mariano Araña.

Ang bangkay ng mga martir na ito ay inilagak sa iisang hukay na hindi natunton kailanman.
rows.inscription_photo: credit: Photo: Jonathan Blaza; perspective correction: Eugene Alvin Villar (seav) {CC BY‑SA 3.0}; file: Labinlimang Martir ng Bikol historical marker 2.jpg; width: 2000; height: 2591
rows.location_description: The historical marker is located at the base of the monument dedicated to the Fifteen Martyrs of Bicol.
rows.location_photo: width: 768; credit: Melandriaromero {CC BY‑SA 3.0}; file: Plaza Quince Martires.jpg; height: 1024

rows.name: Jose Ma. Panganiban y Enverga
rows.address: Naga Central Road, Naga, Camarines Sur
rows.inscription_tl: Manunulat at pantas ng kilusang propaganda. Isinilang, 1 Pebrero 1863, Mambulao (ngayo’y Jose Panganiban), Camarines Norte. Nag-aral sa ilalim ng mga pari ng La Congregacion de La Mision de San Vicente de Paul sa Seminario Conciliar de Nueva Caceres (ngayo’y Holy Rosary Minor Seminary), Nueva Caceres (ngayo’y Lungsod ng Naga), Camarines Sur. Nag-aral ng medisina sa Barcelona, Espanya, 1888, at naging aktibo sa Kilusang Propaganda sa pamamagitan ng pagsulat ng mga artikulo sa La Solidaridad na uminog sa kalayaan sa pamamahayag at reporma sa sistema ng edukasyon sa Pilipinas. Yumao sa Barcelona, 19 Agosto 1890, na ipinagluksa ng komunidad ng mga Pilipino sa Europa.
rows.inscription_photo: width: 3120; credit: Carlo Joseph Moskito {CC BY‑SA 4.0}; file: Jose Ma. Panganiban historical marker.jpg; height: 4160
rows.location_description: The historical marker is located on a concrete mounting beside the monument dedicated to Jose Ma. Panganiban.
rows.location_photo: height: 4160; file: Jose Maria Panganiban Monument.jpg; credit: Carlo Joseph Moskito {CC BY‑SA 4.0}; width: 3120

rows.name: Simbahang Parokya ng Quipayo
rows.address: Quipayo Church, Calabanga, Camarines Sur
rows.inscription_tl:
Isa sa pinakamatatandang simbahan sa Kabikolan. Ito ay itinatag noong 1578 ng mga misyonerong Pransiskano na sina Prayle Pablo de Jesus at Bartolome Ruiz. Pinakaulo ng mga naunang misyon, ang bayan ay sumakop sa mga bisita ng Ligmanan (Libmanan), Bangon (Siruma), Calabangan (Calabanga) at Bombon hanggang sa ang mga ito ay nagsarili noong mga taong 1586, 1687, at 1749, ayon sa pagkakabanggit. Mula noong 1902 hanggang sa kasalukuyan, ang Quipayo ay naging parokyang baryo ng bayan ng Calabanga.

Buhat sa orihinal na nipa at kahoy ang kasalukuyang simbahang tisa ay ipinatayo sa pamamahala ni Prayle Francisco Gaviria noong 1616. Gayunman, ang harapan ng simbahan ay nagiba nong 1949 dahil sa malakas na pag-ulan. Patrona ng parokya ay ang Birhen ng Imakulada Konsepsiyon. Noong 1659, naging pangalawang patron nito si San Roque.
rows.inscription_photo: width: 2432; file: Quipayo Church National Historical Institute marker.jpg; credit: Jun pasa {CC BY‑SA 4.0}; height: 3653

rows.name: Simbahan ng San Francisco
rows.address: San Francisco Parish Church, Peñafrancia Avenue, Naga, Camarines Sur
rows.inscription_tl: Kauna-unahang simbahan sa Naga at isa sa pinakamatanda sa Kabikulan na itinayo noong 1578. Naging tirahan ng misyonaryong Pransiskano. Pinalaki noong 1883; nasira noong 1915 at nanatiling hindi ginagamit hanggang sa maitayo ang kasalukuyang simbahan noong 1957. Sa pook ding ito sumuko sa mga Pilipino ang huling gobernador ng Ambos Camarines noong 18 Setyembre 1898.
rows.inscription_photo: credit: Carlo Joseph Moskito {CC BY‑SA 4.0}; file: Simbahan ng San Francisco historical marker.jpg; width: 3120; height: 4160

rows.name: Philtranco Service Enterprises, Inc.
rows.address: Philtranco Transport Heritage Museum, Iriga–Baao Road, Iriga, Camarines Sur
rows.inscription_tl: Unang pinanganlang Albert Louis Ammen Transportation Company (ALATCO). Ang unang kompaniya na pampasaherong bus ng mga Amerikano sa Pilipinas na itinatag noong 1914 ni A.L. Ammen, isang sundalong Amerikano, at ang punong himpilan ay sa Iriga, Camarines Sur. Ang pook na ito ay ginamit na garison ng Hukbong Imperyal na Hapon noong Ikalawang Digmaang Pandaigdig na nagbunga sa pansamantalang pagtigil ng paglilingkod na pambayan nito. Nagpasimulang muli noong 1945 sa Tabaco, Albay. Binili ng D. Tuason, Inc., noong 1949 at naging simula ng pagiging isa nitong korporasyong pag-aari ng mga Pilipino. Binili nito nang taong ding yaon ang Bicol Transportation Company (BITRANCO). Ang Consolidated Auto Lines (CAL) at Mindoro Transportation Company (MINTRANCO) noong 1954. Nakasanib ang Eastern Tayabas Bus Company (ETBCO), 1968. Binili ng Mantrade Group of Companies noong 1971 at pinanganlang Pantranco South Express Incorporated. Binigyan ng bagong pangalang Philtranco Services Enterprises, Inc., 1985.
rows.inscription_photo: height: 3264; width: 2448; file: Philtranco Marker.jpg; credit: Ringer {CC BY‑SA 4.0}
rows.location_description: The historical marker is located on the wall immediately to the right of the entrance to the Philtranco Transport Heritage Museum.
rows.location_photo: credit: Free2barredo {CC BY‑SA 4.0}; file: Philtranco Transport Heritage Museum.jpg; width: 4128; height: 3096

rows.name: Church of Bula
rows.address: Bula, Camarines Sur
rows.inscription_en: The town dates from 1578. The first church was destroyed by fire in 1676. The second church, built in 1688, was destroyed by a typhoon in 1700. The present Church was completed in 1706 and repaired in 1876 and 1885.
rows.inscription_photo: credit: Yawrei {CC BY‑SA 4.0}; file: Church of Bula signage WTR.JPG; width: 1632; height: 2464

rows.name: Church of Cagsaua
rows.address: Cagsawa Ruins, Pan-Philippine Highway, Daraga, Albay
rows.inscription_en: The spiritual administration of Cagsaua from 1587 to 1595 was under the parish of Camalig. An early church was burned, 25 July 1636, by the Dutch who ransacked the towns bordering Legaspi Bay. This Church built after 1724 by Fray Francisco Blanco, O. F. M., was buried by rocks and lava during the eruption of Mayon Volcano, 1 February 1814. The authorities of Cagsaua meeting at Ligao, 6 July 1814, decided to incorporate their town as part of Daraga. The first centenary of the destruction of the church was commemorated, 1 February 1914, with a huge pilgrimage to the ruins where high mass was celebrated.
rows.inscription_photo: height: 6016; file: Historical Marker at the Church of Cagsaua.JPG; credit: Jonathan Blaza {CC BY‑SA 3.0}; width: 4000
rows.location_description: The historical marker is located at the southwestern corner of the ruined church tower.
rows.location_photo: credit: Wijo08 {CC BY‑SA 3.0}; file: Cagsawa Church Ruins.jpg; width: 4288; height: 2848

rows.name: Simbahan ng Daraga
rows.address: Daraga Church, Santa Maria Street, Daraga, Albay
rows.inscription_tl: Ipinatayo ng mga paring Pransiskano na yari sa bato, 1773. Dito lumipat ang mga mananampalataya ng Cagsawa matapos masira ang kanilang simbahan sa pagsabog ng Mayon, 1814. Inialay sa patronato ni Nuestra Señora de la Porteria, 1854. Ginamit na himpilan ng mga Hapones at nasira noong Ikalawang Digmaang Pandaigdig, 1945. Muling ipinaayos, 1971–1973. Halimbawa ng istilong Baroque ayon sa kahusayan ng mga manggagawang Filipino noong panahon ng mga Espanyol.
rows.inscription_photo: credit: Photo: Jonathan Blaza; perspective correction: Eugene Alvin Villar (seav) {CC BY‑SA 3.0}; file: Simbahan ng Daraga historical marker.jpg; width: 3000; height: 3911

rows.name: Dambana sa Batalay
rows.address: Batalay Shrine, Brgy. Batalay, Bato, Catanduanes
rows.inscription_tl:
Bilang pagpapahalaga sa mga kaugaliang katutubo na nagpasalin-salin sa mga henerasyon ng mga taga-Katandungan at upang gunitain ang Agustinong si Padre Diego de Herrera, ang unang misyonerong Kristiyano ng ekspedisyong Legazpi–Urdaneta na inilibing sa pook na ito noong 1576. Dinadalaw ng mga manlalakbay pangrelihiyon sa buong lalawigan ng Catanduanes.

Inihayag ng obispo ng Lungsod ng Legazpi na isang Diocesan Shrine ng Banal na Krus noong Abril 1, 1973.

rows.name: Mga Moog ng Bulusan
rows.address: Tanggulang Punta Diamante, Gov. Juan Reyes Street, Poblacion, Bulusan, Sorsogon
rows.inscription_tl: Itinayo upang depensahan ang mga mamamayan ng Bulusan at ang Punta de Bulusan, na mahalagang daungan para sa mga manlalayag at sa mga barkong galyon sa Embocadero mula sa pagsalakay ng mga Moro, ika-18 hanggang ika-19 na siglo. Bahagi ng mga istrukturang ito ang mga moog sa Macabari, Busaingan at Gate na ngayo’y sakop na ng mga bayan ng Barcelona, Sta. Magdalena at Bulan, Sorsogon.
rows.inscription_photo: width: 1200; file: Ang Moog ng Bulusan historical marker.jpg; credit: National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP); height: 1600
rows.location_photo: credit: National Historical Commission of the Philippines; file: Ang Moog Ng Bulusan.jpg; width: 1600; height: 1200

rows.name: Ang Escuela Pia ng Prieto–Diaz
rows.address: Prieto Diaz Central School, Prieto Diaz, Sorsogon
rows.inscription_tl: Itinayo na gawa sa kurales sa ilalim ng mga Kastila ayon sa arkitektura ng Escuela Pia noong ikalabinsiyam na dantaon. Ipinagpatuloy bilang paaralang pambayan noong panahon ng mga Amerikano at ngayo’y kabilang sa mga gusali ng Prieto–Diaz Central School. Isinaayos nang masira ng Bagyong Reming, 2006 ng GMA Kapuso Foundation Inc., bilang bahagi ng programang “Unang Hakbang sa Kinabukasan,” 2007.

rows.name: First Rizal Monument
rows.address: Rizal Park, Magallanes Iraya Street cor. Justo Lukban Street, Daet, Camarines Norte
rows.inscription_en: First Rizal Monument in the Philippines. Erected by voluntary contributions of the People of Camarines Norte, led by Lt. Col. Ildefonso Alegre and Lt. Col. Antonio Sanz of the Revolutionary Army. Unveiled on 30 December 1898.
rows.location_description: The historical marker is located at the base of the monument.

rows.name: Martir ng Camarines Norte
rows.address: Rizal Park, Magallanes Iraya Street cor. Justo Lukban Street, Daet, Camarines Norte
rows.inscription_tl: Alaala sa mga Katipuneros at mga dakilang anak ng Daet at mga karatig bayan na nag-alay ng buhay para sa Inang Bayan noong 1898: Ildefonso Moreno, Tomas Zaldua, Telesforo Zaldua, Marianito Zaldua, Jose Abaño, Jacinto Rada, Vicente Salveria, Isidro Avila, Gavino Saavedra, Domingo Lozada, Angel Zaleta, Gregorio del Valle at Florante Bacerdo at marami pang iba.

rows.name: Labanan sa Legazpi
rows.address: Quezon Avenue cor. Rizal Street, Legazpi, Albay
rows.inscription_tl: Sa bayang ito, noong Enero 23, 1900, buong giting na nakipaglaban sa mga sundalong Amerikano ng Ikatlong Batalyon ng ika-47 Impanterya, mga boluntaryo ng E.U. na pinamumunuan ni Brig. Hen. William A. Kobie, ang humigit-kumulang na 800 manghihimagsik na Pilipino sa pamumuno ni Kom. Antonio Reyes. Ang pambobomba sa trintsera ng nagtatanggol na mga Pilipino sa baybayin ng Legazpi ang sapilitang nagpaurong sa kanila sa noon ay tulay ng San Rafael. Dito sila buong tapang na nakipaglaban nang dikitan (mano-mano) sa tumutugis na mga Amerikano. May mga 200 nagtatanggol, kabilang na si Kom. Reyes, ang buong kabayanihang nasawi sa labanang ito.

rows.name: Simbahan ng Camalig
rows.address: Camalig Church, R. Nasol Street cor. B. Buena Street, Camalig, Albay
rows.inscription_tl: Itinayo ng mga Fransiskano ang unang simbahan yari sa kahoy at nipa sa patronato ni San Juan Bautista, 1579–1580. Itinayo ng mga bilanggo ang pangalawang simbahan yari sa bato, 1605. Nasira nang pumutok ang Bulkang Mayon, 1766 at 1814. Muling ipinatayo nina Padre Francisco Latoba at Padre Manuel Brihuega, 1837. Ipinagawa ang harapan ng simbahan, kampanaryo at Escuela Catolica ni Padre Miguel Barcela, 1845. Pinamunuan ng mga Fransiskano sa mahigit na apat na dantaon, 1579–1983.
rows.inscription_photo: file: Camalig Church NHI Marker.jpg; credit: Maningsambale {CC BY‑SA 4.0}; width: 3024; height: 4032
rows.location_description: The historical marker is located on the church facade column immediately to the right of the main door.
rows.location_photo: height: 840; width: 1124; file: Camalig Church entrance and historical marker.jpg; credit: Maningsambale {CC BY‑SA 4.0}

rows.name: Jose Ma. Panganiban y Enverga
rows.address: Jose Panganiban, Camarines Norte
rows.inscription_tl:
Manunulat, siyentipiko, orador at propagandista. Isinilang noong Pebrero 1, 1863, sa Mambulao (ngayo’y Jose Panganiban) Camarines Norte. Nag-aral, mababang paaralan sa seminaryo ng Nueva Caceres (ngayo’y Naga), mataas na paaralan sa San Juan de Letran, Maynila. Kung saan nakamit ang A.B., at Medisina sa Pamantasan ng Santo Tomas at Pamantasan ng Barcelona, Espanya. Mananalaysay at tagasalingwika ng La Solidaridad. Namatay sa Barcelona noong Agosto 19, 1890.

Bilang alaala, sinulat ni Jose Rizal: “Namatay siyang hindi naisakatuparan ang isang dakilang adhikain na inilaan sa kanya ng kanyang talinong hindi-mapantayan. Hindi luha ang kanyang pinakamimithing kasaysayan kundi ang nakikitang gawa: Hindi para sa kanyang sarili, kundi para sa kanyang bayan.”
rows.inscription_photo: credit: National Historical Commission of the Philippines; file: Jose Maria Panganiban historical marker in Jose Panganiban, Camarines Norte.jpg; width: 1200; height: 1600
rows.location_photo: width: 1600; credit: National Historical Commission of the Philippines; file: Jose Ma. Panganiban y Enverga Monument 02.jpg; height: 1200

rows.name: Jesse M. Robredo
rows.address: Jesse Robredo Museum, J. Miranda Avenue cor. Taal Avenue, Naga, Camarines Sur
rows.inscription_tl:
Punong Lungsod ng Naga, Kalihim ng Kagawaran ng Interyor at Lokal na Pamahalaan, at Pangulo ng League of Cities of the Philippines.

Isinilang sa Lungsod ng Naga, Camarines Sur noong ika-27 ng Mayo 1958. Nagsimula siya sa serbisyo publiko bilang Program Director ng Bicol River Basin Development Program noong 1986. Nahalal siya bilang Punong Lungsod ng Naga noong 1988 at nagsilbi nang 19 taon, mula 1988–1998 at 2001–2010. Bilang isang lingkod-bayan, ginawaran siya ng Ramon Magsaysay Award para sa kaniyang pagsulong ng aktibong pakikilahok ng taumbayan sa pamamahala. Itinalaga siya bilang Kalihim ng Interyor at Pamahalaang Lokal noong 2010. Bilang kalihim, ipinatupad niya ang Full Disclosure Policy upang tiyaking tapat at wasto ang paggamit ng lokal na pamahalaan sa pera ng bayan. Pumanaw siya noong ika-18 ng Agosto 2012. Bilang pagkilala sa kanyang natatanging nagawa sa mabuting pamamahala, ipinagkaloob sa kaniya ang Lehiyong Pandangal ng Pilipinas na may ranggong Punong Komandante at ang Krus ng Serbisyo ni Quezon, ang pinakamataas na karangalang maigagawad ng Republika.
rows.inscription_photo: file: Jesse M Robredo NHI Marker.jpg; credit: Irvin Parco Sto. Tomas {CC BY‑SA 4.0}; width: 1728; height: 2592

rows.name: Ang Astilyero sa Isla ng Bagatao
rows.address: Sitio Pansod, Brgy. Behia, Bagatao Island, Magallanes, Sorsogon
rows.title_tl: Ang Astilyero sa Isla ng Bagatao
rows.inscription_tl: Sa pook na ito na dating kilala bilang Calaguimi, itinatag ang Real Astillero de Bagatao sa panahon ni Gobernador-Heneral Juan de Silva, 1610. Dito ginawa ang ilang mga barko para sa Kalakalang Galyon ng Manila–Acapulco kabilang ang pinakamalaki at tanyag na Santisima Trinidad na sa kasamaang palad ay nakuha ng mga Ingles noong 1762. Sinalakay ng mga pirata noong 1616, kung saan maraming Pilipino ang nasawi at mga paring Espanyol ang nadakip. Muling sinalakay noong 1627 at 1635. Ang Astilyero ng Bagatao ay tumagal ng 140 taon.

rows.name: Bantayog para sa Kapayapaan
rows.address: Pinaglabanan Shrine, Km. 348 Pan-Philippine Highway, Brgy. Laniton, Basud, Camarines Norte
rows.inscription_tl: Sa tulay na ito, ganap na ika-4:30 n.u., ika-18 ng Disyembre 1941, nasaksihan ang unang pagpapaputok ng USAFFE Camarines Norte Station ni W.Q. Vinzons laban sa pambungad na hanay ng lumulusob na hukbong imperyal ng Hapon na binubuo ng 120 sundalo. Ang pangkat na ito ni Vinzons na kinikilala ng APWESPAC bilang Vinzons Division-Tlirk Command ang kauna-unahang yunit ng gerilya sa Pilipinas noong Ikalawang Digmaang Pandaigdig. Ang unang pakikipaglabang ito ng mga gerilya ay kinasangkutan din nang lumaon ng USAFFE Reconnaissance, 51st Div. PA., na binubuo ng 16 na sundalo at pinamumunuan ng isang Amerikano at dalawang Pilipinong opisyal at tinulungan ng mga boluntaryong sibilyan. Ang bantayog na ito ay itinayo para sa diyos at sa tao, sa kapayapaan at kalayaan.
rows.wikipedia_articles: Philippines Campaign: Philippines campaign (1941–42); Wenceslao Vinzons: true

rows.name: Angela Manalang Gloria
rows.address: Smith, Bell and Company House, Rizal Street cor. J. B. Berces Street, Tabaco, Albay
rows.inscription_tl: Makata at manunulat. Isinilang sa Guagua, Pampanga, 2 Agosto 1907. Nagtapos ng Bachelor of Arts major in Philosophy, summa cum laude, sa Unibersidad ng Pilipinas, 1929. Ikinasal kay Celedonio Gloria, 1929. Naging patnugot ng Philippine Herald Magazine, 1929. Kauna-unahang Filipinang makata na nagsulat at naglimbag ng koleksyon ng mga tula sa wikang Ingles na pinamagatang Poems, 1940. Yumao sa Tabaco, Albay, 19 Agosto 1995.
rows.inscription_photo: height: 960; width: 717; credit: Tabunon {CC BY‑SA 4.0}; file: Hm angelaManalangGloria.jpg

rows.name: Bahay-Kalakal ng Smith, Bell & Co. Tabaco, Albay
rows.address: Smith, Bell and Company House, Rizal Street cor. J. B. Berces Street, Tabaco, Albay
rows.title_tl: Bahay-Kalakal ng Smith, Bell & Co. Tabaco, Albay
rows.inscription_tl: Ipinatayo ni Mariano Villanueva noong ikalabinsiyam na dantaon at kinilala bilang isa sa mga pinakamalaking bahay sa bayan ng Tabaco. Naging pag-aari ng Smith, Bell & Co. at ginamit bilang sangay ng kumpanya sa Tabaco, Albay hanggang sa mabili ni Angela Manalang Gloria, 1965, at tinirahan ng pamilya. Natatanging halimbawa ng bahay na bato noong panahon ng mga Espanyol sa Albay.
rows.inscription_photo: height: 960; width: 717; file: Hm bahayKalakal.jpg; credit: Tabunon {CC BY‑SA 4.0}
rows.wikipedia_articles: Smith, Bell and Company House: true

rows.name: Katedral ng Albay
rows.address: Legazpi Cathedral, Rosario Street, Legazpi, Albay
rows.inscription_tl: Itinatag ng mga Pransiskano ang misyon sa Albay na dating visita ng Cagsaua, 1587. Itinayo ang unang simbahang yari sa kahoy at nipa sa patronato ni San Gregorio Magno. Naging ganap na parokya, 1616. Ipinaayos gawa sa tabla, 1635. Nasunog, 1754. Itinayo yari sa bato ni Padre Pedro Romero, 1834. Nasunog noong digmaan laban sa mga Amerikano, 1900. Nasira ang ilang bahagi noong Ikalawang Digmang Pandaigdig at ipinaayos ni Padre Nicanor Belleza, 1945. Naging katderal at luklukan ng Diyosesis ng Legazpi, 1951.
rows.inscription_photo: height: 1600; width: 1200; credit: National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP); file: Katedral ng Albay historical marker.jpg
rows.location_description: The historical marker is located at the base of a column to the right of the main entrance.
rows.location_photo: height: 1600; width: 1200; file: Katedral ng Albay facade.jpg; credit: National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP)

rows.name: Church of Legaspi
rows.address: Legazpi Church, Aguinaldo Street cor. Peñaranda Street, Legazpi, Albay
rows.inscription_en: From 1587 to 1616 the spiritual administration of this town was under Cagsaua. The church together with several hosues, was burned in 1754. The eruption of Mayon Volcano, February 1, 1814, destroyed the new church and half of teh town. In 1856 the old name Pueblo Viejo was officialy changed to Legaspi. The present church was built in 1834, mainly through the generosity of Pedro Romero.
rows.inscription_photo: height: 3347; width: 3025; credit: Photo: Jonathan Blaza; perspective correction: Eugene Alvin Villar (seav) {CC BY‑SA 3.0}; file: Church of Legaspi historical marker.jpg

rows.name: Bicol Regional Training and Teaching Hospital
rows.address: Bicol Regional Training and Teaching Hospital, Legazpi, Albay
rows.title_tl: Bicol Regional Training and Teaching Hospital
rows.inscription_tl: Nagsimula bilang isang military reserve hospital na bahagi ng Regan Barracks Reservation; pinasinaayan bilang Albay Provincial Hospital, 1917. Itinayo ang kasalukuyang gusali na yari sa kahoy at kongkreto, 1926–1928. Naging garison ng puwersang Hapon noong Ikalawang Digmaang Pandaigdig. Nagpasimulang muli, 1945. Naging Albay Provincial Health Office, 1984 at pinasinayaan bilang Bicol Regional Training and Teaching Hospital sa bisa ng Republic Act No. 8051, 1995.
rows.inscription_photo: height: 1826; credit: National Historical Commission of the Philippines; file: Bicol Regional and Teaching Hospital historical marker.jpg; width: 1411
rows.location_description: The historical marker is located on a concrete mounting.
rows.location_photo: height: 2144; width: 1564; file: Bicol regional traning and teaching hospital.jpg; credit: Historical Marker Hunter Pilipinas {CC BY‑SA 4.0}

rows.name: St. Agnes’ Academy
rows.address: St. Agnes Academy, Rizal Street, Legazpi, Albay
rows.inscription_tl: Itinatag bilang paaralang pamprimarya ng Missionary Benedictine Sisters ng Tutzing, Germany, 1 Hulyo 1912. Pinangalanang Academia de Sta. Ines sa patronato ni St. Agnes ng Roma. Binuksan ang paaralang pansekundarya, Hunyo 1917. Pansamantalang isinara, Oktubre 1918. Inilipat sa kasalukuyang pook, 1920. Pinasinayaan, 22 Pebrero 1921. Muling binuksan, Hunyo 1921. Ginamit na pagamutan at kanlungan ng mga mamamayan ng Legazpi, Abril 1–28, 1945. Nasira noong Ikalawang Digmaang Pandaigdig. Ipinatayo ang ibang bahagi ng paaralan, 1946. Tumanggap ng mga mag-aaral na lalaki sa sekundarya, 1983.
rows.inscription_photo: height: 1477; width: 1057; file: St. Agnes Academy historical marker.jpg; credit: National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP)
rows.wikipedia_articles: St. Agnes Academy: St. Agnes Academy (Legazpi City)

rows.name: Simeon Arboleda Ola
rows.address: National Road, Guinobatan, Albay
rows.inscription_tl: Heneral ng Himagsikang Pilipino at Digmaang Pilipino–Amerikano sa lalawigan ng Albay. Ipinanganak sa Guinobatan, Albay, 2 Setyembre 1865. Hinatulan ng pamahalaang kolonyal ng Amerika ng 30 taong pagkabilanggo sa salang sedisyon. Ginawaran ng kapatawaran, 8 Oktubre 1904. Presidente Municipal ng Guinobatan, 1910–1919. Yumao, 14 Pebrero 1952.
rows.inscription_photo: credit: National Historical Commission of the Philippines; file: Simeon Arboleda Ola historical marker 01.jpg; width: 206; height: 275
rows.location_photo: height: 701; width: 498; credit: National Historical Commission of the Philippines; file: Simeon Arboleda Ola monument.jpg

rows.name: Jorge Barlin é Imperial
rows.address: Jorge Barlin Monument, Rizal Street, Baao, Camarines Sur
rows.inscription_tl:
Unang Pilipinong Obispo. Ipinanganak sa Baao, Camarines Sur, Abril 23, 1850. Inordenang pari, 1874, at pagkaraan ay hiniring na Capellan de Solio at mayordomo ng Katedral ng Nueva Caceres, kura paroko ng Siruma, Camarines Sur, 1880, at Libog, Albay, 1883; vicario foraneo ng lalawigan ng Sorsogon at kura paroko ng kabisera nito, 1887. Namahala ng lalawigan ng Sorsogon, 1896. Tagapagtanggol ng mga karapatan ng Simbahang Katoliko. Pinagkalooban ng mitra ng Caceres sa lihim na konsistoryo ng Baticano, Disyembre 14, 1905, at kinonsegrahang obispo sa Maynila, Hunyo 29, 1906. Nag-imbokasyon sa pagbubukas ng Asembleya ng Pilipinas, Oktubre 16, 1907. Namatay sa Roma, Setyembre 16, 1907.

Sa bisa ng Kautusan ng Pangulo bilang 260, 1 Agosto 1973, na sinusugan ng mga Kautusan bilang 375, 14 Enero 1974, at bilang 1505, 11 Hunyo 1978, ito ay ipinahayag na Pambansang Bantayog.
rows.inscription_photo: height: 930; width: 639; credit: National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP); file: Jorge Barlin y Imperial historical marker.jpg
rows.location_description: The historical marker is located on the base of the monument of Jorge Barlin.
rows.location_photo: file: Jorge Barlin National Monument, Baao, Camarines Sur.jpg; credit: Joelaldor {CC BY‑SA 4.0}; width: 3216; height: 2136

rows.name: Church of Baao
rows.address: Baao Church, Rizal Street, Baao, Camarines Sur
rows.inscription_en: This church built in 1684 at the junction of Langday and Bahay rivers, was ruined by a typhoon in 1706. Constructed in 1720, the second church lasted until 1731, when the town, which was transferred to its present site, erected another church. This was damaged by the earthquake of 1811 but was repaired in 1850. Its belfry was rebuilt in 1848.
rows.inscription_photo: height: 1304; file: Church of Baao historical marker.jpg; credit: Historical Marker Hunter Pilipinas {CC BY‑SA 4.0}; width: 1612

rows.name: Church of Calabanga
rows.address: Calabanga Church, San Francisco Street, Calabanga, Camarines Sur
rows.inscription_en: The ecclesiastical administration of Calabanga belonged with Quipayo up to 1749. The first church was destroyed by the earthquakes of 1811. The third church was built in 1849. The present church was constructed between 1874 and 1897.
rows.location_description: The historical marker is located on the church facade to the right of the main entrance.
rows.location_photo: height: 1872; width: 3328; credit: FroyAgta {CC BY‑SA 4.0}; file: Calabanga Church Marker.jpg

rows.name: Church of Magarao
rows.address: Magarao Church, Calabanga Road, Magarao, Camarines Sur
rows.inscription_en: The ecclesiastical administration of Magarao belonged with Canaman until 1750. The first church was destroyed by the earthquakes of 1811. The second provisional church built of bamboo and nipa thatch lasted until 1826. Started that year the present church was completed in 1849. The church and the convent, which were seriously damaged by the earthquakes of March 1887, were repaired by the Rev. Vicente Rojo and the Rev. Higinio del Alamo, O.F.M.

rows.name: Tangcong Vaca Guerilla Unit
rows.address: San Nicolas Street, Canaman, Camarines Sur
rows.inscription_tl: Itinatag ni Elias V. Madrid sa baryo San Nicolas, bayan ng Canaman, lalawigan ng Camarines Sur upang labanan ang mga Hapon, 8 Marso 1942. Si Maj. Juan Q. Miranda, nagsilbing namumunong opisyal at Leon Aureus, opisyal na tagapagpatupad. Tumulong sa pagpapalaya sa bayan ng Naga kasama ang ibang gerilya, 3 Mayo 1942. Naging tanyag sa Labanan sa Taguilid Pass sa bayan ng Pamplona, Camarines Sur na ikinasawi ng maraming sundalong hapon, 8 Nobyembre 1942. Lumaban kasama ang iba pang hukbong gerilya upang palayain sa pangalawang pagkakataon ang bayan ng Naga, 13 Abril 1945. Nakipaglaban sa mga Hapon hanggang mapalaya ang iba pang mga bayan ng Camarines Sur, 1945.
rows.location_description: The historical marker is located on a tall concrete mounting.
rows.location_photo: height: 1365; credit: National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP); file: Unveiling of Tangkong Vaca Guerilla Unit historical marker 01.jpg; width: 2048

rows.name: Kapitolyo ng Sorsogon
rows.address: Sorsogon Provincial Capitol, Sorsogon City, Sorsogon
rows.inscription_tl: Ang tahanan ng angkang De Vera ay naging unang tanggapan ni Gobernador Bernardino Monreal simula 1902. Pansamantalang naging opisina ang kanlurang bahagi ng gusali ng mataas na paaralang panlalawigan habang ginagawa ang gusaling kapitolyo. Itinayo yari sa kongkreto ang kapitolyo ng Sorsogon sa istilong neo-classical kasabay ang gusaling hukuman at panlalawigang piitan sa pangangasiwa nina Arkitekto George Fenhagen at Ralph H. Doane sa panunungkulan ni Gobernador Victor Eco, 1915–1917. Itinayo ang monumento ni Jose Rizal sa harapan ng kapitolyo sa pangangasiwa ni Arkitekto Juan Arellano sa ilalim ng administrasyon ni Gobernador Bernabe Flores Palma, 1923.
rows.inscription_photo: credit: National Historical Commission of the Philippines; file: Kapitolyo ng Sorsogon historical marker 01.jpg; width: 1405; height: 2048

rows.name: Church of Milaor
rows.address: Milaor Church, Milaor, Camarines Sur
rows.inscription_en: The first church, started in 1725 and completed in 1735, was destroyed by fire in 1740. The present Church was constructed in 1740, its belfry in 1840.
rows.inscription_photo: credit: Irvin Parco Sto. Tomas {CC BY‑SA 4.0}; file: Historical marker of Milaor Church.jpg; width: 2656; height: 3984

rows.name: Simbahang San Pedro Apostol
rows.address: Saint Peter the Apostle Church, San Pedro Street cor. Francisco O. Balce Street, Vinzons, Camarines Norte
rows.inscription_tl:
Pinakamatandang simbahan sa Camarines Norte. Ang bayang ito ay itinatag ng mga paring Pransiskano noong 1581 at pinangalanang Tacboan. Noong 1611 isang simbahang nasa pagtangkilik ni San Pedro Apostol ang ipinatayo ng Reb. P. Juan de Losar, ang unang kura paroko. Noong 1624 ang bayan ay inilipat sa ibang pook at tinawag na Indan. Isang bagong simbahan ang ipinatayo sa pagtangkilik pa rin ng unang patron.

Noong 1636 ang Bisita ng Labo ay itinatag ng mga misyonero at isinanib sa Indan. Taong 1661 nang ang pangasiwaan nito ay ipinagkaloob sa klerikong sekular.

Pagkatapos ng Ikalawang Digmaang Pandaigdig ang Indan ay binigyan ng bagong pangalang Vinzons na isinunod kay Wenceslao Q. Vinzons, ang bayani ng Kabikulan ng nakaraang Digmaan.

Ang kaliwa at kanang bahagi ng kasalukuyang simbahan ay ipinagawa sa pamamagitan ng tulong ng mga nasasakupan ng parokya.
rows.wikipedia_articles: Saint Peter the Apostle Church: Saint Peter the Apostle Church (Vinzons)

rows.name: Birthplace of Wenceslao Q. Vinzons
rows.address: Sta. Cruz Street, Brgy. I, Vinzons, Camarines Norte
rows.inscription_en: Here on 28 September 1910, was born Wenceslao Q. Vinzons, lawyer, 1933; delegate to the Constitutional Convention, 1934; provincial governor of Camarines Norte, 1940; congressman, 1941; first lieutenant, reserved, Philippine Army. At the outbreak of World War II in the Philippines, he organized a citizen army and fought valiantly at Laniton and Tigbinan, 17 December 1941. Captured treacherously, 6 July 1942, and executed by the enemy.

rows.name: Paracale
rows.address: Paracale Municipal Hall, Real Street cor. Candelaria Street, Brgy. Poblacion Norte, Paracale, Camarines Norte
rows.inscription_tl:
Itinatag na misyon ng mga Pransiskano noong 1581. Ang simbahan ay ipinatayo noong 1611 sa ilalim ng Patronang Nuestra Señora de Candelaria. Nilisan ng mga misyonero noong 1662; nagbalik noong 1687 hanggang sa ilipat ang misyon noong 1696. Noong 1863, ito ay pormal na itinatag bilang bayan. Ang mga Pransiskano ay nagbalik noong 1880 at muling ipinagawa ang simbahan noong 1886 hanggang 1898.

Isang korporasyong Ingles ang pinagkalooban ng mga Kastila ng konsesyon ng mina subalit natigil noong Himagsikan ng 1896. Ang kalakasan ng pagmimina ng ginto ay noong 1936.

rows.name: Camilo Jacob
rows.address: National Highway, Polangui, Albay
rows.inscription_tl: Rebolusyonaryo at isa sa Quince Martires ng Bikol. Isinilang sa Polangui, Albay, kalagitnaan ng ika-19 na siglo. Naging kasapi ng Triangulo, Bikol, isang masoneriya sa Camarines na naghangad na mapabuti ang kalagayan ng bayan. Dinakip at nilitis ng Korte Militar dahil sa bintang na rebelyon, 29 Disyembre 1896. Binaril sa Bagumbayan kasama ang iba pang mga Bikolanong nahatulang rebelde ng mga Espanyol, 4 Enero 1897.

rows.name: Potenciano V. Gregorio Sr.
rows.address: San Isidro Road, Santo Domingo, Albay
rows.inscription_tl: Kilalang musiko at kompositor. Isinilang sa Libog (Santo Domingo)[,] Albay, 19 Mayo 1880. Nag-aral ng Musika sa pamamatnubay ni Mons. Jorge I. Barlin, 1883–1885. Katulong ang kapatid na si Bernardo, kumatha ng humigit-kumulang sa 12 dakilang komposisyon. Nilikha ang “Sarung Banggi,” naging klasikong awitin sa Kabikulan, 10 Mayo 1910. Pinangunahan ang Banda de Libog hanggang 1918. Sumapi sa Philippine Constabulary Band na pinamunuan ni Kor. Walter H. Loving, 1918. Isinaayos ang “Sarung Banggi” para sa banda, 1918–1919, at para sa orkestra, 1930. Hinirang na Kinatawan ng Banda ng Philippine Constabulary sa eksposisyon sa San Francisco, Estados Unidos, 1939. Pumanaw sa sakit na pulmonya samantalang patungo sa eksposisyon, 12, Pebrero 1939.
rows.inscription_photo: height: 2717; credit: Ringer {CC BY‑SA 4.0}; file: Potenciano V. Gregorio Sr. historical marker.jpg; width: 2136
rows.location_description: The historical marker is located on the plinth of the bust of Potenciano V. Gregorio, Sr.
rows.location_photo: height: 4608; file: Potenciano Gregorio monument.jpg; credit: National Historical Commission of the Philippines; width: 3456

rows.name: Church of Nabua
rows.address: Nabua Church, Nabua–Balatan Road cor. Pan-Philippine Highway, Nabua, Camarines Sur
rows.inscription_en: This town dates from 1578. Built in 1578. The first church was burned in 1610. The second church, constructed in 1611 was destroyed by a typhoon. The third church was erected between 1630 and 1656. The present church, completed in 1700, was unroofed by a typhoon in 1875, but repaired in 1878. The belfry was damaged by an earthquake in 1850 but repaired between 1890 and 1894.
rows.inscription_photo: file: Church of Nabua historical marker.jpg; credit: Photo: TEAM PILTIK; perspective correction: Eugene Alvin Villar (seav) {CC BY‑SA 4.0}; width: 2225; height: 2449

rows.name: Church of Iriga
rows.address: Iriga Church, Rizal Street, Iriga, Camarines Sur
rows.inscription_en: The first church was burned in 1585. The second church was damaged by a typhoon and destroyed by fire. The third church, constructed in 1727, was also burned in 1841. The present church, together with the two belfries, was constructed shortly afterwards.
rows.inscription_photo: width: 2464; file: Church of Iriga historical marker.jpg; credit: Yawrei {CC BY‑SA 4.0}; height: 1632

rows.name: Church of Buhi
rows.address: Buhi Church, Iriga-Buhi Road corner Magsaysay Street, Buhi, Camarines Sur
rows.inscription_en: An early church built close to Buhi Lake was destroyed by fire in 1730. Another church was finished in 1735, but was damaged at various times by earthquakes. The present church was built by Rev. Angel Malumbre, O.F.M., between 1870 and 1884. The roof was destroyed by fire the same year it was finished and repaired in 1889–1890.
rows.inscription_photo: height: 1483; width: 1473; credit: Rizalynsahagun11 {CC BY‑SA 4.0}; file: Church of Buhi historical marker (cropped).jpg

rows.name: Universidad de Santa Isabel
rows.address: Universidad de Sta. Isabel, Elias Angeles Street cor. Santonja Street, Naga, Camarines Sur
rows.inscription_tl: Ipinahayag bilang Pambansang Palatandaang Pangkasaysayan ng Pambansang Komisyong Pangkasaysayan ng Pilipinas, 26 Pebrero 2018.
rows.inscription_photo: width: 2234; credit: Ryomaandres {CC BY‑SA 4.0}; file: Universidad de Santa Isabel NHCP Historical Marker.png; height: 1997

rows.name: Heneral Jose Ignacio Paua
rows.address: Daraga–Legazpi City–Tiwi Road cor. Emilio Jacinto Street, Legazpi, Albay
rows.subtitle_tl: Heneral na Tsino sa Himagsikang Pilipino
rows.inscription_tl: Ipinanganak sa nayon ng Laona, Lammua, Fookien, Tsina noong Abril 29, 1872. Dumating sa Pilipinas noong 1890. Lumahok sa Himagsikang Pilipino. Inatasan ni Heneral Emilio Aguinaldo sa pagtatatag at pamamahala ng isang arsenal at pagawaan ng armas sa Imus. Buong giting na nakipaglaban sa iba’t ibang labanan sa Cavite, Bulacan, Pampanga, Pangasinan at Tarlac. Tanging Tsino na lumagda sa Konstitusyon ng Biyak-na-Bato, 1897. Itinalagang mangilak ng pondo sa Kabikulan noong Digmaang Filipino–Amerikano. Nakulong sa Kutang Santiago. Pinalaya noong Hunyo 21, 1900. Nanirahan sa Manito, Albay, kung saan nahalal bilang presidente municipal. Namatay noong Mayo 24, 1926.
rows.inscription_photo: height: 885; credit: National Historical Commission of the Philippines; file: Heneral Jose Ignacio Paua historical marker.jpg; width: 651
rows.location_photo: file: General Jose Ignacio Paua Monument.jpg; credit: National Historical Commission of the Philippines; width: 1096; height: 1600

rows.name: Pagdaong sa Legazpi
rows.address: Albay Gulf Landing Commemoration Site, Brgy. Rawis, Legazpi, Albay
rows.inscription_tl: Dito dumaong ang 158th Infantry Regimental Combat Team ng US 6th Army na pinamunuan nina Brig. Gen. Hanford MacNider at Capt. Homer McGee upang palayain ang bayan ng Legazpi mula sa mga Hapones, 1 Abril 1945. Katulong ang mga gerilyang pinamunuan ni Lt. Col. Demetrio Camua. Nabawi ang San Bernardino Strait na nagpadali sa rutang pandagat mula sa Maynila patungong Karagatang Pasipiko, Samar at Leyte. Ito ang huling pagdaong ng Hukbong Amerikano sa Luzon na nagpalaya sa Kabikulan.
rows.wikipedia_articles: 158th Infantry Regiment: 158th Infantry Regiment (United States); Battle of Luzon: true

rows.name: Seminary of Nueva Caceres
rows.address: Holy Rosary Minor Seminary, Elias Angeles Street, Naga, Camarines Sur
rows.inscription_en: The Seminary of Nueva Caceres was founded by the Rt. Rev. Domingo Collantes, O.P., Bishop of Nueva Caceres, March 7, 1797. The first building which stood near this site was badly damaged by a typhoon in October 1856 and destroyed by fire August 22, 1860. The seminary was reconstructed by the Rt. Rev. Francisco C. Gainza, O.P., Bishop of Nueva Caceres, and turned over to the Vincentian Fathers May 7, 1865 for the training of the diocesan clergy. From 1892 to 1925, the Vincentian Fathers also maintained a college for the education of the young men of the Bicol region. In the first seventy-five years of its existence, the seminary gave 370 priests to the church and four bishops to the Philippine hierarchy.
rows.location_photo: height: 1296; file: WTNaga HIJAB B20c.JPG; credit: Froilan Lozares {CC BY‑SA 3.0}; width: 1944

rows.name: Simbahan ng Barcelona
rows.address: Barcelona Church, Barcelona, Sorsogon
rows.inscription_tl: Itinatag ang parokya sa patronato ni San Jose kasabay ng pagtatag ng bayan ng Barcelona na binuo mula sa Danlog at Tagdon, mga bisita ng Gubat; Layog at Macabari, mga bisita ng Bulusan, 1865. Ipinatayo ang simbahang yari sa korales at batong-buhay na may estilong neo-classical, 1874. Napasailalim sa Diyosesis ng Sorsogon mula sa Diyosesis ng Nueva Caceres, 1951. Isinaayos ng Pambansang Komisyong Pangkasaysayan ng Pilipinas, 2020.
rows.inscription_photo: file: Church of Barcelona historical marker (cropped).jpg; credit: National Historical Commission of the Philippines (NHCP); width: 468; height: 570
rows.location_description: The historical marker is located on the church facade immediately to the left of the main door.

rows.name: Salvador Escudero Sr.
rows.address: Philippine National Police Provincial Headquarters, Camp Salvador Escudero Sr., Eternidad Street, Sorsogon City, Sorsogon
rows.inscription_tl: Gerilya at lingkod-bayan. Isinilang sa Casiguran, Sorsogon, 7 Marso 1887. Nanungkulan bilang konsehal at alkalde ng Casiguran, 1912. Itinalagang gobernador ng Sorsogon, 1941. Pinamunuan ang Escudero unit sa ilalim ng Southern Bicol Area Command noong Ikalawang Digmaang Pandaigdig. Hinirang bilang koronel at pinuno ng rehimyento ng Sorsogon na inatasang itatag ang Filipino-American irregular troops sa lalawigan, 1943. Lihim na nagpadala ng impormasyon sa mga puwersang Amerikano noong kasagsagan ng Ikalawang Digmaang Pandaigdig. Nahalal na gobernador at pinagtuunan ang kapayapaan at kaayusan sa lalawigan ng Sorsogon, 1946–1955. Yumao, 27 Disyembre 1978.
rows.inscription_photo: credit: National Historical Commission of the Philippines; file: Salvador Escudero Sr. (1887-1978) historical marker 01.jpg; width: 1536; height: 2048
rows.location_description: The historical marker is located on the plinth of the bust of Salvador Escudero Sr.
rows.location_photo: height: 2048; credit: National Historical Commission of the Philippines; file: Salvador Escudero Sr. (1887-1978) historical marker 02.jpg; width: 1536

rows.name: Restoration Marker
rows.address: Museo Sorsogon, Sorsogon City, Sorsogon
rows.inscription_en: The old provincial jail in Sorsogon City, considered an Important Cultural Property under Republic Act No. 10066, was restored by the Department of Public Works and Highways. The restoration works were done by Centerways Construction and Development, Incorporated. Its conversion into a local museum was undertaken by the National Historical Commission of the Philippines and its curatorial works were done by Centrex Corporation. On 12 March 2021, the National Historical Commission of the Philippines represented by Chairman Rene R. Escalante turned over the new Museo Sorsogon to the Province of Sorsogon represented by Governor Francis Joseph G. Escudero. This event was witnessed by Deputy Speaker Evelina G. Escudero and Sorsogon City Mayor Ma. Ester E. Hamor.
rows.location_description: The historical marker is located on the building facade immediately to the right of the main entrance.
